8393101: Add support for SVE String.indexOf

Implements String.indexOf by scanning for the first and
last characters of the needle within the haystack and using those
found characters to compare the rest of the needle to the haystack
substring. It supports both Latin1 and UTF-16 encodings, and cases
where the haystack is UTF-16 and the needle is Latin1.

Support for arbitrary-length needles is present, but needles of length 1
are handled via the `string_indexof_char_sve` helper instead.

The benchmarks below are compared to the commit `64e0cf4`, and used the
TEST="micro:IndexOf.*" pattern.
The Delta column is the relative multiplier of the avgt metric (ms/op) as
measured on the Arm Neoverse V2 and Arm Neoverse V3 platforms. Lower is better.
